provenance.asset_description: Art by Mirco Paganessi: Pathfinder iconics, Seltyiel and Kyra and starfinder iconics Navasi and Dae dressed in stylized semi-modern outfits. Seltyiel wears a dress covered in layered ruffles, Kyra, wears a blue fitted suit, Navasi is dressed in white top with a purple skirt referencing magical girls, and Dae wears a loose purple suite with an open jacket and fedora.
